hypotheses.name: scGPT lung H1 persistence exceeds feature-shuffle null
hypotheses.method: Computed ripser H1 persistence on PCA-reduced (20D) scGPT layer gene embeddings (350 genes/layer) for 3 seeds with 20 feature-shuffle null replicates per seed-layer via conda run -n subproject40-topology python iterations/iter_0003/run_iter0003_screen.py
hypotheses.result_value: L0 delta=18.603, z=3.213, Fisher p=0.0056; 11/12 layers Fisher p<0.05
hypotheses.next_action: Replicate the same persistent-homology null protocol on immune and external-lung runs, then enforce source/target-disjoint robustness.

hypotheses.name: Cross-model feature-effect alignment across domains
hypotheses.method: Aligned scGPT and Geneformer delta_cv_auroc vectors for centered_cosine/dot/cosine in immune, lung, external_lung and evaluated exact permutation null over feature index assignments.
hypotheses.result_value: mean cosine=0.825, mean Spearman=0.833, combined cosine Fisher p=0.349
hypotheses.next_action: Materialize matched-gene residual embeddings for Geneformer and rerun alignment at residual-vector level with CKA/Procrustes and stronger nulls.
